title: The Rapid Adoption of Generative AI
research_question: How quickly and intensively are US adults adopting generative AI at work and at home?

data.sample: more than 10,000 respondents in August and November 2024

method.design: weighted repeated cross-sectional survey benchmarked to CPS
method.boundary: self-reported use and time savings; not a causal productivity estimate

findings.claim: By late 2024, 39% of US adults age 18-64 reported generative-AI use and 23% of employed respondents used it for work in the prior week.
Respondents reported AI assistance over roughly 1-5% of work hours and time savings equivalent to 1.4% of work hours.

limitations: Use and time savings are self-reported.
Early diffusion patterns do not identify employment or productivity effects.
